title: Senior Market Manager, Luxe
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>As a Luxe Senior Market Manager, you will drive supply growth for Airbnb Luxe in your assigned geographies — acquiring new listings and cultivating host relationships that define Luxe. You will serve as the on-the-ground market expert, combining&nbsp; deep knowledge of luxury real estate and travel landscape with a consultative, relationship-first approach to acquisition and account management.</p> <p>You will work with Luxe Guest Services, Content &amp; Quality, and cross-functional teams to ensure every home meets Airbnb Luxe's standards. This role is equally focused on strategic growth and day-to-day excellence - you'll be equally comfortable prospecting net-new hosts, conducting business reviews, and rolling up your sleeves to solve host challenges.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <h4><strong>Supply Acquisition &amp; Pipeline Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead net-new host and listing acquisition in assigned markets, moving qualified leads through the funnel to meet and exceed quarterly supply goals</li> <li>Prospect and identify high-quality homes through external research, networking, and partnerships with luxury real estate professionals, property managers, and operators</li> <li>Qualify incoming leads and deliver fully vetted hosts and listings to the onboarding team with clear handoff documentation</li> <li>Compellingly articulate Airbnb Luxe's value proposition across all formats — phone, email, in-person — tailored to the luxury audience</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Market Development &amp; Launches</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own new market launches end-to-end, including lead generation, host recruitment, coordination with Home Quality and Guest Services, and post-launch performance monitoring</li> <li>Develop a nuanced understanding of your markets: desirable neighborhoods, architectural styles, design aesthetics, pricing trends, seasonality, and the competitive landscape</li> <li>Build and maintain localized pitches that resonate with luxury homeowners and real estate professionals in your region</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Host Account Management &amp; Optimization</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage a portfolio of Luxe hosts, serving as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor</li> <li>Conduct regular business reviews and optimization calls to uncover challenges, identify growth opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations</li> <li>Support onboarding of new listings for assigned hosts, ensuring a seamless experience</li> <li>Design and deploy strategies to manage and optimize long-tail hosts across your markets</li> <li>Improve listing bookability through performance analysis and targeted host education</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Escalations</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Act as the primary liaison between assigned hosts and internal teams (Guest Services, Content &amp; Quality, Product, Policy) for escalated issues and strategic initiatives</li> <li>Serve as an effective "air traffic controller" — routing host requests to the right internal resources while maintaining direct host accessibility</li> <li>Cascade host feedback to relevant stakeholders to inform product and policy decisions</li> <li>Educate hosts on significant product updates, policy changes, and platform best practices</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>8+ years of relevant experience in sales, account management, business development, or strategic partnerships — ideally within luxury travel, hospitality, or real estate</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding acquisition and/or revenue targets in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally across teams to influence change and drive results</li> <li>Familiarity with CRM tools and the ability to maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and reporting</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills &amp; Competencies</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility and influence senior decision-makers both internally and within the luxury industry</li> <li>Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to close complex, high-value partnerships</li> <li>Sharp market instincts — you can quickly assess a neighborhood, identify a trend, and translate that into actionable strategy</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to craft compelling pitches and maintain polished host-facing correspondence</li> <li>Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholder relationships simultaneously</li> <li>Comfortable operating with ambiguity and adapting quickly in an ever-evolving environment</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Mindset</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Deep alignment with Airbnb's mission and a passion for the luxury travel and homes space</li> <li>A consultative, relationship-first approach — you build trust before you close deals</li> <li>Proactive, solutions-oriented, and self-directed; you don't wait for problems to escalate</li> <li>Collaborative by nature — you understand that success in this role is a team sport</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Location Specific Requirements:</strong></span></p> <p><em>This role is based out of European Ski (France, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, Germany) overseeing European ski destinations. It requires up to 50% travel to markets across European ski, as well as occasional team off-sites.</em></p> <p><em>English and French or Italian proficiency required. Additional languages (French/Italian/German) nice to have</em></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The Ethereum Foundation

The Ethereum Foundation (EF) is a global non-profit organization dedicated to supporting Ethereum. Our mission is to help Ethereum remain secure, decentralized, and resilient over the long term by supporting critical protocol work and the broader ecosystem.

The role

The Protocol Security team helps prevent vulnerabilities from reaching Ethereum mainnet.

We work across the execution layer, consensus layer, networking, specifications, testing, and client implementations to identify security issues before they become production incidents. Our work combines deep protocol knowledge with security research, manual review, fuzzing, AI-assisted analysis, audits, and coordinated disclosure.

We're looking for engineers who already understand Ethereum deeply.

The strongest candidates are already active in Ethereum protocol development. Ideally you have deep experience with the execution layer, consensus layer, specifications, testing infrastructure, or other protocol-critical components.

What you'll work on

Examples include:

  • AI-assisted security research and automated bug discovery.

  • Reviewing upcoming hardforks.

  • Finding vulnerabilities across Ethereum protocol implementations.

  • Building and improving fuzzers.

  • Improving the team's automation and security tooling.

  • Manual security review of Ethereum protocol changes.

  • Working closely with Protocol DevOps, Specifications, researchers, and protocol implementers.

  • Coordinating responsible disclosure.

  • Supporting external audits and audit competitions.

What we're looking for

We're primarily looking for people with deep Ethereum protocol experience.

Ideal backgrounds include:

  • Deep familiarity with the execution layer or consensus layer.

  • Deep familiarity with EL or CL specifications.

  • Experience implementing or reviewing protocol changes.

  • Strong understanding of Ethereum networking, consensus, or execution internals.

Security experience should include one or more of:

  • AI-assisted security workflows.

  • Protocol security research.

  • Fuzzing.

  • Vulnerability research.

  • Manual application security review.

  • Building security tooling.

Languages commonly used include Go, Rust, Java, C#, Nim, and Python.

We're much less concerned with a specific number of years than with demonstrated technical depth.

raw.description:
The Mission

OroraTech is a global intelligence-as-a-service company leveraging thermal data from space. As we continue to grow, expand our activities, and develop our organization, the effective execution of our most important company priorities becomes increasingly critical.

We are looking for a highly structured and proactive Chief of Staff to work closely with our CEO and support the execution of selected strategic and cross-functional initiatives.

You will help translate company priorities into clear projects, responsibilities, and next steps. You will independently own assigned projects end-to-end, prepare strategic decisions, and coordinate initiatives involving different functions and senior stakeholders. You will act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO while working closely with the Executive Team and leaders across OroraTech. You will report directly to the CEO.


What you’ll be doing

This is the first Chief of Staff role at OroraTech. The areas below are where we expect you to start. Which of them matter most, and what else belongs in the role, is something you and the CEO will shape together over your first months.


Launching Strategic Projects & Company Priorities

  • Own selected company-level initiatives from initial scoping through to a delivered result.
  • Turn broad priorities into a plan with clear owners, milestones, and a defined outcome, then bring the right people from across the company together to deliver it.
  • Do the thinking yourself where it matters: structure the problem, run the analysis, and form a view.
  • Spot the risks and dependencies others are not tracking, and come to the CEO with a recommendation rather than an open question.
  • Stay with an initiative after the decision is made, through the part where momentum sometimes fades.
  • Establish clear follow-up mechanisms and ensure that agreed actions and decisions are implemented.


Mission control: Strategy and operating cadence

  • Support the company’s strategic planning cycle and coordinate the OKR process end to end.
  • Prepare and facilitate Executive meetings, leadership reviews, and strategy sessions: agenda, pre-reads, and decisions recorded with an owner.
  • Maintain a clear view of what the company has committed to and where each commitment stands.


Executive communication and external stakeholders

  • Prepare board materials, investor updates, and decision papers for the CEO and Executive Team, drawing input from relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare with the CEO ahead of board meetings, partnership discussions, and external engagements, and make sure the follow-ups are picked up.
  • Support investor relations and board processes as they arise.
  •  Contribute to selected initiatives in governmental and regulated markets, working with the internal experts who own the content.

CEO & Executive Team Support

  • Prepare briefings, analyses, and recommendations for important meetings and decisions.
  • Act as an interface between the CEO, Executive Team, and key internal stakeholders.
  • Help ensure that the CEO’s involvement is focused on the topics where it creates the greatest value.
  • Take ownership of urgent and important special projects that do not clearly sit within one function.
  • Build trusted relationships across the organization and influence progress without relying on formal authority.


Relevant Skills

Required

  • Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, corporate development, venture capital, a founder’s office, or a comparable role.
  • Strong experience independently managing complex projects involving multiple functions and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong business judgment and a good understanding of how strategy translates into operational execution.
  • Excellent project management, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical and presentation skills, including the ability to create concise decision and management materials.
  • Confidence working with executives while remaining pragmatic, hands-on, and execution-oriented.
  • Ability to build trust and influence across the organization without formal authority.
  • High level of discretion, reliability, and personal ownership.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology company, scale-up, or similarly dynamic environment.
  • Experience supporting fundraising, investor relations, or board-related processes.
  • Experience establishing or coordinating strategy, OKR, governance, or operating-cadence processes.
  • Exposure to space, aerospace, defence, government technology, climate technology, or other complex technical industries.


Our Benefits

At OroraTech, you can expect a down-to-earth, yet high-caliber work environment. You will become an integral part of the OroraTech satellite development - a talented, international, open-minded team that is highly motivated to create impact. OroraTech gives you the opportunity to grow on a professional and personal level. Be part of the solution to climate change.
Our Benefits include: 

  • A responsible position with individual autonomy and design freedom 
  • Company pension scheme (bAV = Betriebliche Altersversorgung) 
  • Company accident insurance (supplementary insurance for accidents during work and leisure time around the world 24/7) 
  • Company international travel health insurance (supplementary insurance covering worldwide travel for business or leisure)
  • Flexible working hours and home office option (including working from other countries within the EU) 
  • Corporate health benefit via discounted EGYM Wellpass subscription 
  • Corporate mental health benefit via nilo
  • Corporate mobility benefit via supplementary payment for the DB Deutschland Ticket 
  • Corporate lunch benefit via hrmony
  • Corporate bike leasing program via JobRad 
  • Modern office at Neue Balan with a wonderful pool and campus area

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>What is the Role</strong></p> <p>We are actively seeking a Customer Architect with an understanding of technology and hands-on experience in key IT domains, notably Observability, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Search. You should possess a strong technical background, preferably with experience in cloud-based software solutions.&nbsp;</p> <p>We value individuals who are passionate about staying at the forefront of technology trends with a growth mindset and excited to learn and implement new technologies. While previous experience with Elastic solutions is not a prerequisite, an eagerness to adopt our suite of solutions and apply them effectively to solve our customers' challenges is critical. This key role involves not only driving the consumption of our Elastic solutions by aligning them with customer business objectives but also onboarding customers, securing adoption, and facilitating expansion.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Customer Architect, you will be the Trusted Technical Advisor, working in tandem with the customer and complementary groups like Field and Services Teams to ensure that Elastic solutions are exceeding customer’s expectations. . Your technical expertise, eye for business, and ability to deliver value will accelerate and improve the customer experience leading to customer continued satisfaction and expansion within the elastic portfolio.&nbsp;</p> <p>In your role, a crucial part of your responsibility is defining and communicating the technical success criteria for our customers. This involves crafting detailed Technical Success Plans tailored to the specific customers goals and critical metrics.</p> <p>The Technical Success Plans act as a roadmap, outlining the optimal consumption and deployment of Elastic solutions in the customer's environment. They detail the necessary steps for implementation, highlight achievements for successful consumption or expansion, and provide and effectiveness aligned to the customer’s business goals. By actioning this plan , you will be seen as the trusted advisor, guiding the customer towards achieving their desired outcomes, thereby ensuring their success and satisfaction.</p> <p>From providing technical guidance and sharing standard methodologies to aligning technical objectives with the customers' business goals, your work is instrumental in facilitating smooth adoption, sustained usage, and increased consumption of our solutions. This hands-on role requires you to be proactive, with a keen understanding of our customers' technical landscape and a commitment to making their journey with Elastic solutions successful and valuable.</p> <p>Your chief aim will be to ensure the customer derives significant value, eliminate technical frictions, and propel the uptake and application of Elastic solutions, with the ultimate goal of growing annual recurring revenue (ARR).<br><br></p> <p><strong>What Will You Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Collaborate closely with the account team, including the Account Executive and the Solutions Architect (Pre-sales engineer), to provide ongoing technical coverage and support, while the account team focuses on identifying new deals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define the technical success plan for each customer, outlining the optimal use of Elastic solutions to achieve their business objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensure a successful technical customer journey, from onboarding to adoption, while continuously driving the consumption of Elastic solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understand and articulate the value proposition of Elastic solutions and align them with the customer's business goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with customers to identify and eliminate technical frictions, promoting a smoother adoption and implementation of Elastic solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Liaise between customers and support, as necessary, to ensure an optimized support resolution experience smoothing the adoption curve for the customer.</p> </li> <li> <p>As a hands-on technical authority, collaborate with the Service Team to deliver personalized, frictionless solutions that meet the unique needs of each customer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer's business needs and translate these into technical requirements for Elastic solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Find opportunities for expansion, at which point the account team takes over to expand the subscription, aiming to grow annual recurring revenue (ARR).</p> </li> <li> <p>Foster ongoing customer relationships, ensuring that customers continue to increase their utilization of Elastic solutions, further driving ARR.</p> </li> <li> <p>Continuously review and assess customer consumption of Elastic solutions, proactively suggesting upgrades and enhancements that increase value and drive further consumption.</p> </li> <li>The nature of the work that you will be doing will require a high percentage of work onsite with customers, and you should be expected to travel as a result of this requirement</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field highly preferred.</p> </li> <li>Fluency in German &amp; English is required for this role. Fluency in French is a plus.&nbsp;</li> <li> <p>Validated experience in a similar role such as Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Pre-sales Engineer, with hands-on experience with Elastic solutions or equivalent technologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experienced with one or more Elastic solutions (Observability, Security, Enterprise Search) or the Elastic stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and how to align them with business objectives is a plus.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication and presentation skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong social skills, with the ability to establish relationships with customers and team members.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-PF1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring. A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. raw.title: (Senior) Account Manager
raw.description:
Your Impact

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

Expanding within the customer base is one of Tacto's biggest growth levers, and we're building it out for the long term. Most mature B2B companies generate 50%+ of their revenue from existing customers - we want to capture more of that potential, and we're strengthening the team to get there. As Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind our expansion motion: identifying and closing upsells, cross-sells, and strategic price increases across our customer base, and helping build and sharpen the playbook as we scale it. You'll work between Sales, Customer Value, and Product, spotting growth opportunities and turning them into revenue. This is your chance to build and grow a crucial commercial function at one of Europe's fastest growing industrial AI companies.

Your Tasks

  • Own deals end-to-end: Identify opportunities, build business cases, run negotiations, close deals. Manage contracts and pricing logic.

  • Master account intelligence: Read customer dynamics, map stakeholders, understand politics. Know when to drive expansion yourself vs. when to bring in AEs or Customer Value. Identify perfect timing for upsells.

  • Coordinate across functions: Coordinate with Sales (pipeline), Customer Success (value-delivery), Product (what to sell), and Finance (forecasting) to drive expansion deals

  • Own forecasting and planning: Build accurate expansion forecasts. Coordinate deal timelines. Keep the business informed and on track.

  • Translate roadmap into revenue: Work with Product and Marketing to turn new modules into concrete expansion conversations with the right customers at the right time.

  • Help building the function as it scales: Turn what you learn into reusable process, qualification criteria, pricing guardrails, forecasting templates, rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value. Where the playbook doesn't exist yet, you help writing it

Your Profile

We're looking for someone who can build, close, and scale. Here's what typically works:

  • 2-4 years in high-performance environments: A proven track record of hitting, and significantly overachieving, quarterly or yearly commercial targets, in account management, sales, or a customer success role with a real commercial component.

  • Proven commercial track record in B2B SaaS companies.

  • Extremely smart and driven – you connect dots quickly, learn fast, and push hard to win

  • Excellent stakeholder management – you navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior buyers (Heads of Procurement, C-Level), and align internal teams

  • Negotiation toughness – you hold your ground in price discussions without burning bridges

  • Process-oriented – you own details: contracts, terms, renewal dates, forecasting

  • Genuine interest in industrial procurement – you want to understand how manufacturing companies work and speak their language

  • Native German + fluent English

Why This Role is Awesome

This is the first dedicated Account Manager seat at Tacto. Some first structures exist, but most of the function is still yours to build: the quota model, the rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value, the process itself. Get this right, and expansion becomes Tacto's biggest new revenue lever within two to three years, that's the scale of upside on the table. Do it well for the first 12 to 18 months, and you define your next step: a bigger book of accounts, leading the function as it grows into a full team, or a move into Sales or Customer Value leadership.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not customer support with a sales quota bolted on. You'll be measured on revenue, not on being liked, and some weeks that means pushing a commercial conversation the customer wasn't asking for.

  • This is not a mature, handed-to-you playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, your own forecast discipline, and parts of the process itself.

  • Prove you can turn module adoption into signed expansion revenue, and we'll back you owning a bigger book, leading the function, or moving into Sales or CV leadership next.

Why Tacto

  • We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. The large majority of our Leadership Team was promoted internally, you deliver impact and the sky is the limit at Tacto.

  • Backed to win big. We're Sequoia and Index Ventures-funded, with more than €50M raised. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Get a glimpse here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

description: Mit DatAds haben wir uns ein großes Ziel gesetzt: Wir wollen den Ad Creative Prozess auf das nächste Level bringen. Unsere Software ist die Brücke zwischen datengetriebenen Performance Marketing und innovativen Creative Teams . Damit ermöglichen wir Performance Marketern und Creative Designern optimal zusammenzuarbeiten und durch AI Analysen mehr erfolgreiche Werbeanzeigen zu erstellen. Wir arbeiten mit einigen der größten eCommerce Brands und Marketing Agenturen zusammen, wie z.B. Holy, yfood, ahead, Rosental, Pammys, Beilmann, Perspective und vielen mehr. Möchtest du Teil eines schnell wachsenden Marketing SaaS-Startups werden und die Reise von DatAds aktiv mitgestalten ? Wir sind ein kleines, vollständig remote arbeitendes Team. Unsere Gründer bringen komplementäre Expertise mit: Max führt den Commercial-Bereich, während unser Daniel (Ex Hubspot) die technische Seite leitet. Ergänzt wird das Team durch eine Tech Person und eine Customer Care Person mit ähnlichem Profil. Aufgaben Kundenerfolg & Beratung: Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer eCom- & Agency-Kunden. Du analysierst bestehende Setups, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und hilfst, DatAds effektiver in ihren täglichen Prozessen zu integrieren. Customer Support: Durchführung von regelmäßigen Calls mit Kunden, Unterstützung über Slack und aktive Begleitung bei strategischen Fragen rund um ihre Creatives & Kampagnen. Upselling & Reaktivierung: Identifizierung von Wachstumschancen bei bestehenden Kund:innen und proaktives Ansprechen von inaktiven oder früheren Leads über unser CRM. Kommunikation & Content: Erstellung von Texten, E-Mails und kurzen Updates zur Kundenbindung, Erfolgskommunikation und Unterstützung von Sales-Aktivitäten. Zusammenarbeit & Eigeninitiative: Enge Abstimmung mit den beiden Gründern Max und Daniel, Einbringen eigener Ideen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer internen Prozesse. Qualifikation Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Performance Ads (z. B. Meta, Google, LinkedIn oder TikTok) – sowohl im operativen Kampagnenmanagement als auch im strategischen Aufbau. Idealerweise Erfahrung in einer Agentur oder als Freelancer:in – du kennst die Dynamik, Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative, die das mit sich bringt. Hands-on-Mentalität – du packst an, statt nur zu analysieren, und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Growth Mindset & Eigenmotivation: Du willst Ergebnisse sehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas aufbauen. Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten in Kundenkommunikation – sowohl schriftlich als auch in Video Calls. Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Berufliches Wachstum : Du wirst aktiv in spannende Projekte eingebunden und hast eine hohe Eigenverantwortung für deine Aufgaben. Eine steile Lernkurve ist garantiert. Dynamische Start-up-Atmosphäre : Schnelle Kommunikations- und Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien, ein talentiertes und motiviertes Founder Team und gemeinsame Celebrations von Erfolgen. Flexibilität bei der Arbeit : Passe deine Arbeitszeiten deinen Bedürfnissen an und genieße die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten + 25 Tage Urlaub Marketing Netzwerk : Finde mit uns deinen Einstieg in die Marketing Szene, lerne von Experten und baue dein berufliches Netzwerk mit Top Leuten aus der Marketing Szene aus. title: Consultant Corporate Finance & Unternehmensnachfolge (m/w/d) - Teilzeit
description: Du verbindest analytische Unternehmensbewertung mit einem klaren Blick für die tatsächliche Finanzierbarkeit? Genau solche Zusammenhänge wollen wir für Menschen verständlich machen, die eine Unternehmensnachfolge vorbereiten, aber selbst keinen M&A-Hintergrund haben. Dafür baust du das Themenfeld Finanzierung, Unternehmensbewertung und M&A in einem neuen bundesweiten Projekt von Grund auf auf. Gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung entwickelst du die fachliche Ausrichtung und entscheidest, wie aus komplexen wirtschaftlichen Fragen verlässliche Informationsangebote entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Fördermittelexpertise zusammen und bringst dein Wissen selbst in Workshops und Veranstaltungen ein. Worum es dabei geht: Jedes Jahr stehen Zehntausende kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in Deutschland vor der Nachfolgefrage. Bleibt sie ungelöst, verschwinden Betriebe, Arbeitsplätze, Wissen und regionale Wertschöpfung. Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dieses Rückgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft zu erhalten und Betriebe mit verständlichen Informationsangeboten und praxisnahen Veranstaltungen dabei unterstützen, Unternehmensnachfolgen erfolgreich vorzubereiten und umzusetzen. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf Unternehmensnachfolgen durch Mitarbeitende – sogenannten Employee Buyouts (EBO) – sowie auf genossenschaftlichen Beteiligungsmodellen. Über uns: NDF ist die auf Fördermittel spezialisierte Marke der Key Progress Makers Advisory GmbH. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Startups und innovativen Unternehmen, die neue Produkte, Technologien oder Geschäftsmodelle entwickeln und dafür passende Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten suchen. Wir helfen ihnen, Förderpotenziale zu erkennen und anspruchsvolle Vorhaben so zu strukturieren, dass aus einer Idee ein tragfähiges Projekt werden kann. Diese Erfahrung bringen wir nun in ein eigenes öffentlich gefördertes Projekt rund um das Thema Unternehmensnachfolge ein. Rahmenbedingungen: Die Stelle umfasst 19,5 Stunden pro Woche. Die Arbeitszeit kann nach Absprache flexibel verteilt werden. Start ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, idealerweise im September 2026. Aufgaben Du entwickelst Workshops, Informationsangebote und digitale Orientierungshilfen zu Unternehmensbewertung, Finanzierung und M&A bei Unternehmensnachfolgen Du vermittelst komplexe wirtschaftliche und finanzielle Zusammenhänge selbst in Workshops, Veranstaltungen und Fachformaten Du entwickelst verständliche Fallbeispiele zu Unternehmenswert, Kaufpreis, Kapitalbedarf, Liquidität und wirtschaftlicher Tragfähigkeit Du bereitest typische Bewertungsverfahren, Finanzierungsmodelle, Dealstrukturen und Transaktionsphasen praxisnah auf Du entwickelst Inhalte für die Projektwebsite, die digitale Plattform und weitere öffentlich zugängliche Informationsformate Du arbeitest eng mit der Fachverantwortung für Fördermittel zusammen und zeigst, wie öffentliche und private Finanzierungsbausteine grundsätzlich zusammenspielen können Qualifikation Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in M&A, Corporate Finance, Unternehmensfinanzierung, Transaction Advisory oder Unternehmensnachfolge Fundierte Erfahrung mit Unternehmensbewertung und Finanzierungsmodellen Sicherer Umgang mit Jahresabschlüssen, BWA, GuV und Bilanz Ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Kapitalbedarf, Liquidität, Kapitaldienstfähigkeit und wirtschaftlicher Tragfähigkeit Erfahrung mit kleinen und/oder mittleren Unternehmen und ein Gespür für die Besonderheiten inhabergeführter Betriebe Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Bewertungs-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsfragen verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Workshops, Informationsformaten oder fachlichen Veranstaltungen Sehr gutes Deutsch und eine sichere professionelle Kommunikation Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise Einen reflektierten Umgang mit digitalen Analysewerkzeugen, Finanzmodellen und KI Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Uns interessiert, an welchen Transaktionen, Finanzierungen oder Bewertungsprojekten du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Verantwortung du dabei selbst übernommen hast und wie du zu belastbaren Ergebnissen gekommen bist. Entscheidend ist für uns außerdem, dass du mit Eigeninitiative und echtem Gestaltungswillen an neue Fragestellungen herangehst. Passende Erfahrungen kannst du beispielsweise aus M&A, Corporate Finance, Transaction Advisory, einer Bank, Beteiligungsgesellschaft oder Nachfolgeberatung mitbringen. … du Freude daran hast, Unternehmen mit deinem Wissen zu tragfähigen Entscheidungen und wirtschaftlichem Erfolg zu verhelfen.

title: Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting
description: Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei? Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting unterstützt du uns dabei, dass die finanziellen Abläufe von VESTIGAS im Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig funktionieren. Du arbeitest unter anderem an Rechnungen, offenen Posten, Buchhaltungsunterlagen und der Vorbereitung unserer Abschlüsse. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Viele unserer Finance-Prozesse werden aktuell aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt. Du erhältst deshalb einen direkten Einblick darin, wie die Finance-Funktion eines wachsenden Early-Stage-Start-ups entsteht – und kannst aktiv dazu beitragen, Abläufe strukturierter, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Finance Managerin sowie unserem Steuerbüro zusammen. Zu Beginn lernst du unsere Prozesse und Systeme kennen, übernimmst operative Aufgaben und baust mit der Zeit deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich aus. Deine Aufgaben Du kontierst Eingangsrechnungen sowie Reisekosten- und Spesenabrechnungen in Moss vor und bereitest die Buchhaltungsunterlagen für unser Steuerbüro auf. Du erstellst Kundenrechnungen und kümmerst dich um die Nachverfolgung offener Forderungen. Du stimmst offene Posten auf Debitoren- und Kreditorenseite ab, behältst Fälligkeiten im Blick und klärst Unstimmigkeiten. Du pflegst Buchhaltungs- und Vertragsunterlagen und sorgst für eine vollständige, nachvollziehbare Ablage. Du wirkst bei der Vorbereitung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse mit und lernst, wie die einzelnen Finance-Prozesse zusammenlaufen. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau neuer Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse, bringst eigene Verbesserungsvorschläge ein und übernimmst mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigenständig ausgewählte Themen. Dein Profil Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang – idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Steuern. Du bringst im idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung im Finance & Accounting mit, z. B. durch ein Praktikum, eine Ausbildung oder ein vorheriges Werkstudium. Du arbeitest strukturiert, genau und zuverlässig, auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben und unter Termindruck. Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und Interesse daran, buchhalterische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und zu verbessern. Du wohnst in erreichbarer Nähe zu unserem Standort in München und bist bereit, regelmäßig im Büro präsent zu sein. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets; erste Erfahrungen mit Spend-Management-Tools ist ein Plus. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Deine Benefits Echte Verantwortung statt Mikromanagement. Du gestaltest mit, du entscheidest mit, du siehst den Impact deiner Arbeit direkt im Markt. Direkter Draht zu Foundern und Leadership. Flache Hierarchien sind bei uns Alltag. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. AI-First-Workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor und Co. sind bei uns selbstverständliches Werkzeug. Wir erwarten und unterstützen ihren Einsatz. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office im Herzen Münchens, unweit der Theresienwiese. Flexibles Modell mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz, weil wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen auch im persönlichen Austausch entstehen. Wellpass oder BahnCard, Corporate Benefits, Team-Events, jährliche Offsites. Faire, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept.


Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Business Operations baust du mit am Betriebssystem von VESTIGAS: an den Prozessen, Daten und Formaten, mit denen wir das Unternehmen steuern – OKR-Prozess und All-Hands, Reporting und Kennzahlen, Datenqualität im CRM und die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe. Bei vielen dieser Themen stehen wir noch am Anfang: Du arbeitest nicht in fertigen Strukturen, sondern legst das Fundament mit.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Lust hat, Dinge selbst anzupacken – der verstehen will, wie es heute wirklich läuft, und daraus Prozesse und Daten macht, die auch bei doppelter Teamgröße noch tragen. Du arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die diese Themen heute federführend vorantreibt: Du hältst ihr den Rücken frei, lernst unmittelbar von ihr und übernimmst mit der Zeit eigene Themen. Und du bekommst einen ehrlichen Blick darauf, wie ein schnell wachsendes Start-up von innen funktioniert.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachhalten unserer wiederkehrenden Steuerungs- und Kommunikationsformate, insbesondere des OKR-Prozesses und unserer All-Hands – von der Aufbereitung der Inhalte bis zum Nachfassen bei den Verantwortlichen.
  • Du führst Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zusammen, bereitest Kennzahlen und Auswertungen auf und behältst die Datenqualität in unserem CRM und weiteren Tools im Blick – inklusive Aufräumen, wo es nötig ist.
  • Du nimmst bestehende Prozesse unter die Lupe, entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen mit und setzt sie um – von Leitfäden und Toolumstellungen bis zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Schritte mit AI-Tools und -Agents.
  • Du übernimmst klar abgegrenzte Themen zunehmend eigenständig und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis zur sauberen, praxistauglichen Lösung.


Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Finance oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit überdurchschnittlichen Leistungen und befindest dich am Ende deines Bachelor- oder bereits im Masterstudium.
  • Du bringst erste einschlägige Praxiserfahrung aus Praktika mit – z. B. aus Beratung oder einem schnell wachsenden Start-up.
  • Du hast Drive: Du denkst mit, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten, erkennst selbst, was als Nächstes zu tun ist, und ziehst Themen auch dann weiter, wenn niemand nachfragt.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig: Was du zusagst, lieferst du – in der abgesprochenen Qualität und Zeit. Und wenn etwas nicht aufgeht, sagst du es früh statt spät.
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und kennzeichnest Unsicherheiten, statt sie zu glätten. Mit unfertigen Themen kommst du klar, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.
  • Mit Excel und PowerPoint arbeitest du routiniert: Du kommst zügig von Rohdaten zu einer Aussage, die man versteht.
  • Du findest dich schnell in neuen Themen, Tools und Systemen zurecht und verstehst Zusammenhänge ohne lange Erklärungen.
  • Du hast eine starke Affinität zu AI Agents und Tools, nutzt sie aktiv, um dir Themen selbst zu erschließen, und verstehst ihre Limits.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch (C1).
  • Du bist bereit, regelmäßig aus unserem Münchner Office zu arbeiten – diese Rolle ist bewusst keine Remote-Position.


Deine Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung statt Mikromanagement. Du gestaltest mit, du entscheidest mit, du siehst den Impact deiner Arbeit direkt im Markt.
  • Direkter Draht zu Foundern und Leadership. Flache Hierarchien sind bei uns Alltag. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • AI-First-Workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor und Co. sind bei uns selbstverständliches Werkzeug. Wir erwarten und unterstützen ihren Einsatz.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office im Herzen Münchens, unweit der Theresienwiese. Flexibles Modell mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz, weil wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen auch im persönlichen Austausch entstehen.
  • Wellpass oder BahnCard, Corporate Benefits, Team-Events, jährliche Offsites.
  • Faire, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice is growing and we are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich. The level offered will reflect your experience, expertise and demonstrated impact.</span></span></h2> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities, and large energy consumers, supporting them to navigate increasingly complex markets, manage flexibility in their portfolio and deliver large-scale transformation programmes. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, and technology delivery.</p> <p>This is your opportunity to combine deep industry exposure with hands-on client delivery, working directly with leading traders, utilities and renewable energy businesses as they transform their trading operations, integrate flexibility assets and adopt new technologies.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>You will work closely with clients on a range of transformation and advisory engagements, including</p> <ul> <li><strong>Trading systems transformation:</strong> Supporting trading landscape design, system selection, implementation, and optimisation for core trading platforms and applications.</li> <li><strong>Digital &amp; trading transformation</strong>: Helping clients embed data strategies, analytics, and AI into trading operations and decision-making processes.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility services &amp; integration:</strong> Supporting the development and integration of flexibility capabilities across assets, technology platforms and commercial operations to maximise value in energy markets.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; business transformation:</strong> Supporting the design and implementation of trading operating models and end-to-end processes across the full commodity and energy trading lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Risk and regulatory advisory:</strong> Strengthening risk and regulatory frameworks, governance, and reporting across trading organisations.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>We welcome professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas across LNG, Gas &amp; Clean Fuels, Power, Metals, or Oil. <br>We recognise that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds, so you do not need experience across all of these areas to apply.</p> <ul> <li>Commodity and energy trading, risk management, market analysis, commercial operations or trading support functions.</li> <li>Trading transformation initiatives, helping organisations improve processes, systems and ways of working across the front-to-back trading lifecycle.</li> <li>Data, analytics and emerging AI-enabled use cases within trading environments.</li> <li>ETRM/CTRM platforms and supporting technologies, including business analysis, requirements gathering, testing, implementation or continuous improvement activities.</li> <li>Market, credit, operational or regulatory risk topics, with an interest in helping trading organisations strengthen governance, controls and performance.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on your experience and interests, you may also bring skills in one or more of the following areas:</p> <ul> <li>Business analysis, problem solving and transformation delivery experience.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and visualisation.</li> <li>Experience working with business and technology stakeholders to deliver practical solutions.</li> <li>An interest in data, analytics, AI and digital technologies within commodity and energy trading.</li> <li>Senior Consultants are expected to demonstrate ownership of workstreams, adapt quickly to complex situations, and thrive in client-facing environments.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in German and English is required for this role.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability


Your profile

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
  • Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions. You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value. This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership

raw.title: Energy Nerd / Developer - Freiburg im Breisgau
raw.description:
“We design the infrastructure systems of tomorrow!” – With you?

We are convinced that the transformation towards sustainable, resilient and efficient infrastructures does not have to be complicated. We provide municipalities, utilities, grid operators and other infrastructure stakeholders with the data, analyses and decision-making tools they need for integrated infrastructure and energy system planning.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a motivated and solution-oriented Project Engineer (m/f/d) with a focus on heating grids to support the implementation of transformation plans and feasibility studies and to contribute to the development of innovative tools and solutions for future-oriented energy systems.

Tasks

  • Design and develop scalable algorithms for energy system modelling
  • Architect, extend and optimise simulation models in Python, ensuring modularity, performant data structures and reusable code
  • Conduct comprehensive and automated analyses of simulation results to extract actionable insights for energy planning
  • Translate local desktop simulations and algorithms into production-ready software architectures for integration into our SaaS platform
  • Establish and document standardised workflows for data integration, geoprocessing and quality assurance
  • Proactively align on-premise and academic tools with the requirements of production SaaS applications
  • Develop and extend greenventory's internal toolbox for energy system modelling and planning
  • Work closely with energy experts, software developers and researchers to turn complex energy system questions into robust technical solutions
  • Continuously improve the performance, maintainability and usability of our modelling and simulation tools

Requirements

  • You have a deep understanding of energy systems and/or computer science
  • You have strong skills in simulation and programming, particularly Python
  • You have experience with Django or comparable Python-based web frameworks
  • You have 2–5 years of practical experience in energy modelling, data science or engineering software development
  • You have experience with Git-based version control and GitHub, including clean commits, pull requests and branching strategies
  • You are familiar with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and linting
  • You have experience with QGIS and geospatial data analysis
  • You are familiar with geospatial Python libraries such as GeoPandas, Shapely and PyProj
  • You have experience with agentic coding and AI-supported development workflows, for example LLMs, Copilots or automated coding agents
  • You are familiar with Agile development environments and code review practices
  • You are interested in SaaS applications and enjoy turning technical concepts into production-ready software
  • You have good communication skills in English
  • You can balance the requirements and expectations of an end research institute environment with the practical needs of greenventory and a production software environment

Benefits

  • Career prospects: Work in a sustainable, socially relevant and absolutely future-proof field.
  • Team spirit: Whether in daily work, regular after-work activities or company outings - look forward to a friendly team where you will be fully integrated from the start and enjoy your work.
  • Flexible working: Whether you're an early bird or a night owl, you can arrange your working hours flexibly. In addition, thanks to hybrid working, you also have the option of working from home occasionally.
  • Fair pay: We offer an attractive and competitive salary package.
  • Personal training and development opportunities: We offer you the opportunity to quickly take on responsibility in projects within a strong team and to grow through new and exciting tasks.
  • We work in a state-of-the-art office with top-of-the-line equipment, based in Freiburg.
  • Health is a high priority for us. We therefore support our employees financially with Hansefit memberships and offer the option of leasing a company bike.
  • Work-life balance: In addition to 30 days of annual leave, we also offer the possibility of working part-time: A 4-day week is no problem for us!

"But why exactly Greenventory?"

With us, you have the opportunity to work in an ambitious team on projects that will shape the future. Through your work, you will make a significant contribution to advancing the energy transition and paving the way to climate neutrality.

You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through offer, ensuring a seamless flow. Regional GTM Expertise: Serve as our first EMEA based GTM recruiter and build the practices needed to hire commercial talent across a wide and varied region. You will stay closely aligned with the US based People Ops team while adapting to local market norms. You will build high quality pipelines so we are not relying solely on inbound applicants for critical commercial roles. Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process. You will ensure scorecards are used effectively to reduce bias, maintaining strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions. Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience by ensuring transparent communication. You will treat candidates with customer centric speed, ensuring decisions are made in days, not months. Partnership: Collaborate with GTM leaders to define the profile of a winning commercial hire in each market. You will act as a consultant on regional compensation, market trends, and closing strategy, not just an order taker. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience, specifically for GTM roles, within a high growth tech startup. Regional Track Record: You have direct experience recruiting senior Account Executives and other commercial talent across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific, and you understand how hiring norms shift across those markets. Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be one of vCluster Labs' first hires on the ground in Europe, working across EMEA, APAC, and US time zones as needed. A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new GTM hiring practices for the region. A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health and inform decision making. High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of both candidates and hiring managers. Bonus points for: ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby. Language Skills: Fluency in additional European languages beyond English or German. Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting GTM talent for open source technology, developer tools, or infrastructure companies. HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle. About vCluster Labs We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
description: Your Impact Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every single customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that gap is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies. Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close it: engineers who sit inside the customer's environment, build in their data, and turn what they learn into product. This function does not exist at Tacto yet. You will build the motion from the start, collaborating with Product, and discover what Forward Deployed Engineering means for Tacto, figuring out how much value we can generate for leading industrials. Your Tasks Build the function. Charter, operating model, quality bar, metrics. Bring this function to the next level. Hire the right talent. The team is there to grow. Hire exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers and build your own high performing team. Own how we engage customers. Design and establish the processes for how engineers scope, embed, build, and hand over. This is the core of the role, not an afterthought to the technical work. Build, hands-on, in customer environments. Agents, pipelines, custom logic on top of our platform, in real production data. You lead by shipping. Turn one-offs into product. Work directly with Product and Engineering to convert what you build at the edge into platform capability. An FDE org that productises nothing is just an expensive consultancy, and you will make sure we never become one. Lead the first FDEs. Find the rare people who are excellent engineers and credible in front of a Head of IT. Set the standard by being it. Own the hardest customer rooms. Lead escalations with Heads of Procurement and IT and be the senior presence customers trust. Be AI-native. Use AI to change what the function is capable of, then measure it, then build it into how the team works. Your Profile 5+ years building software close to customers: forward deployed or deployment-style engineering, technical program leadership in a product company, or an engineering-heavy path through top-tier consulting at Manager level or above. You write code and you want to keep writing it. Python and SQL at working level, comfortable with data pipelines and integration architecture. 1+ years leading engineers, or you have built something from zero and had people follow you into it. Zero-to-one operator. You are comfortable when the process does not exist yet, and you write it down instead of holding it in your head. Product instinct. You can tell a one-off from a pattern and you will argue the case either way. Senior presence with customers, including C-level escalations, and the backbone to be clear about what we will and will not commit to. Native or C1 German, fluent English. Why This Role is Awesome You are not inheriting a team, you are defining a function that most companies in enterprise AI are only starting to understand they need. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you own one of Tacto's core technical organisations, with a direct line into the product roadmap and a hand in how leading global industrials adopts AI. What This Role Is - and Isn't This is not a people-management role with technical decoration. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job. This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what customers can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform. The first months will be ambiguous by design: you, a handful of accounts, and a blank page. If that reads as risk rather than opportunity, this is not a good fit. Why Tacto Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI. A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier. High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring. A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term. Interview Process Intro call with our Talent team Deep dive with Head of Customer Experience Onsite case study and discussion on future of FDEs Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. What We Offer The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have: Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
